full_prompt_en: A square Renaissance-style engraved landscape is enclosed by a thin double-line border on warm paper. Two old towns face each other across a steep river gorge. On the left, stacked stone buildings climb from dark cliffs, including a tall narrow tower at the outer edge. On the right, similarly crowded houses balance the composition, their balconies and small windows arranged in layered blocks above a rocky bank. The gorge opens down the center, where a pale river winds toward distant low mountains and a horizontal sea or plain. Jagged rocks, little plants, and tiny human figures occupy the lower corners, making the built slopes feel high and deep. Above the gap, the sky is heavily worked with curling cloud forms. A bright opening slightly left of center sends straight, fine rays downward and sideways toward the valley. A small orb appears at upper right among the clouds, adding an emblematic detail to the otherwise geographic view. Every surface is drawn in black ink with fine parallel lines and crosshatching. Foreground cliffs and shadowed walls are dense and dark; the distant river, mountains, and sky use fewer lighter lines so the paper remains visible. Some contours are assertive and architectural in the case scene, while textures within stone, cloud, and water are composed of many small directional cuts. There is no color beyond black, cream, and aged gray. Illumination is indicated by radiating line and preserved paper white rather than smooth tonal wash; its contrast lifts the central distance against dark flanking masses. The image feels both topographic and allegorical, with a formal border containing a dramatic passage from crowded sides to bright far opening.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形文艺复兴式风景刻版画由暖纸上的细双线边框围住。两座古城隔着陡峭河谷相望。左侧层叠石楼从深色悬崖上升，最外缘有一座细高塔。右侧同样密集的房屋平衡构图，阳台与小窗在岩岸上方排成层层色块。峡谷从中央打开，一条浅色河流蜿蜒通往低远山与水平海面或平原。锯齿岩石、小植物与微小人物占据下方两角，使建筑坡面显得高且深。谷口上方，天空由卷曲云形密密刻画。中央略偏左处一片亮口向山谷下方和侧面发出笔直细光线。右上云间还有一个小圆球，为原本地理性的景象添一处象征细节。每个表面都用黑墨细平行线与交叉排线绘成。前景崖壁和背阴墙密而暗；远方河流、山与天空的线更稀更浅，纸面因此透出。案例里的某些轮廓坚实并带建筑形状，而石、云、水内部纹理由许多小定向刻痕组成。除了黑、奶油纸色和旧灰，没有其他颜色。照明由放射线与保留纸白表示，而非平滑明暗水洗；对比让中央远处从两侧深暗体量中升亮。图像兼具地形感与寓言感，一道正式边框容纳从拥挤两侧通往明亮远方开口的戏剧通道。
style_prompt_en: A classical black-ink engraving on warm aged paper uses a precise inset border and dense directional hatching to build a dramatic symmetrical framework. Heavy dark clusters fill both sides and the lower corners, opening into a narrow pale central recession. Fine parallel cuts model hard planes; curled layered marks shape softer upper masses; light-distance passages leave more of the paper untouched. Straight hairline rays extend from one upper opening, crossing a delicately lined middle field and making brightness feel almost emblematic. The palette is limited to ink black, warm cream, and intermediate grays created by line spacing. Scale shifts from highly detailed near textures to sparse remote marks, giving depth without color or smooth shading. Crisp contours coexist with many small irregular strokes, and the aged sheet retains slight paper discoloration. The overall effect is formal, intricate, and expansive, with balanced dark flanks directing attention through an illuminated central corridor.
style_prompt_zh: 暖旧纸上的古典黑墨刻版以精确内框与密集定向排线建立戏剧性的对称骨架。厚重深暗簇群填满两侧和下角，向狭窄浅色中央退远处打开。细平行刻痕塑造坚硬平面；卷曲层叠记号形成较柔的上方体块；受光远处保留更多未触碰纸白。笔直发丝细光线从上方一处开口延出，穿过细线刻出的中层，使亮度几乎带象征性。配色限于墨黑、暖奶油与由线距产生的中间灰。尺度从细节极多的近处纹理变为稀疏远方记号，不靠色彩或平滑阴影也能表现纵深。清楚轮廓与许多不规则小刻痕共存，旧纸仍有轻微变色。整体正式、繁复而辽阔，平衡的深暗侧翼把注意力引向发亮中央通道。
theme_en: Two old towns facing across a rocky river gorge beneath radiating sunlight
theme_zh: 两座古城隔着岩石河谷相望，上方天光放射
name: Marcantonio Raimondi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
